content: SQLite official WAL documentation and 3.51.3 release log confirm WAL-reset bug fixed in 3.51.3 and later with backports 3.44.6/3.50.7; PRAGMA synchronous documentation states NORMAL WAL mode can lose committed transactions on power loss while FULL provides durable commits subject to storage sync guarantees. VORTEX should inspect embedded sqlite_version/source_id and effective connection settings before durable grant issuance. Sources: https://www.sqlite.org/wal.html https://www.sqlite.org/releaselog/3_51_3.html https://sqlite.org/pragma.html#pragma_synchronous
